target_customer: Hardware companies in EV charging, motor drives and energy storage that need custom chips without building a chip team
problem: Custom silicon is costly and slow for small hardware companies. Visibl positions as an AI native design partner that cuts ASIC cost and timeline on mature nodes, starting with power electronics.
business_model: Design services and partnership from specification to production silicon, with an AI coordination layer for chip design
product_category: AI native custom silicon design partner

founders.name: Bryce Neil
founders.background_notes: YC page says he is a computer engineer with two Canadian academic scholarships, school not named. He built production software and data systems for healthcare and the public sector in U.S. hospitals.

competitors.name: ChipAgents
competitors.what: Agentic AI platform for semiconductor design
competitors.funding_then: $50M Series A1 in February 2026, $74M total per press

competitors.name: Cognichip
competitors.funding_then: $60M Series A in April 2026, about $93M total per press

competitors.name: Architect Labs
competitors.what: AI custom chip design for production silicon with early partners

technical_complexity.rationale: Delivering working custom silicon through production involves chip design expertise, foundry access and tooling. The team of three relies on engineers with Microsoft, Intel and Arm experience per the website, but their names were not found.

defensibility.rationale: Well funded AI chip design startups and the big EDA vendors target the same wedge. A services plus tooling model has weak lock in until it builds reference designs and customer data.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Press reports that Synopsys, Cadence and Siemens EDA keep embedding AI into their toolchains in 2026. No action against Visibl specifically is public.

market_need_then: Investors poured money into AI chip design startups in 2025 and 2026, and edge silicon interest returned per SemiEngineering. Small hardware firms still lack access to custom chips. Visibl's own demand evidence was not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses visiblsemi.com, a shortened form of the company name.

identity.logo: Uppercase wordmark VISIBL SEMICONDUCTORS with a trademark symbol
identity.visual_style: Plain wordmark with a YC backed orange logo
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, practical: A Faster Path to Custom Silicon

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand was found. The misspelling of visible and a similar carrier name make it confusable.

outcome_analysis: Visibl Semiconductors is a Winter 2026 YC company with a team of three and no verified funding. The position is crowded with far better funded AI chip design startups and incumbent EDA vendors. No outcome is visible yet, and the early signals are a thin public footprint and no named customers.
notes: Funding unverified: one aggregator says Robinhood Ventures Fund II invested in 2026-08, another shows a $130K YC seed, and a Crunchbase entry lists pre-seed with placeholder text. None recorded as a round. An aggregator names Jordon Kashanchi as CTO and co-founder, and the YC launch post mentions a Jordon, but the YC page gives no last name or background, so he is not listed as a founder. Founding year 2024 comes from aggregators only. No outcome news found.
